scenarios.name: Press Escape with the command-source list open and a pending edit

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list
the user clicks the add command button
"2D Sketches" appears in the target list
the target shows a pending-change marker
the user opens the command-source list
the Part Tools target is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
